evidence.reason: The first launch had a stuck SteamVR UI and the game was started again without preparing a fresh run ID. The second process is retained only as diagnostic evidence.

observations: The VR menu pointer can now select items, but its motion is chaotic and difficult to control.
Walking and jumping remain unacceptable; movement input still reaches essentially full magnitude, so clipped stick range is not the cause.
The local player model still enters the headset view after room-scale motion/recenter. The rejected candidate was applying vertical HMD translation to the visual pelvis.
Shooting remains impossible to aim reliably. The rejected candidate published controller direction/origin, but the actual PSVR2 Sense /pose/tip axis convention was not independently measured.
The right arm still visibly contorts. Diagnostic samples reached 175.008 degrees of forearm takeover and 179.47 degrees of hand residual.
No validation state advances from this run because the run ID was reused across two processes and every exercised playability area remained rejected.
